impl.diagController: src/ContosoUniversity.Web/Controllers/DiagController.cs (NEW) — [AllowAnonymous] [Route("Diag")] GET /Diag/Throw; throws InvalidOperationException only when IsDevelopment, returns 404 in non-dev
